watch.summary: The streamer accidentally alters his character's hiding pose while camouflaged against a wall painting, leading to a panicked attempt to fix it.

beats.what: Streamer accidentally presses the pose key while hidden.
He changes pose, breaking his seamless camouflage.
He panics and frantically cycles through the pose menu trying to remember his original position.
He gets an out-of-bounds warning and screams as his character clips awkwardly.
He finds a pose that works and settles back into the wall.
He laughs nervously in relief, admitting he doesn't know what to do.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The comedic value comes from his immediate panic after accidentally ruining a perfect hiding spot. His frantic cycling through silly poses creates a classic slapstick situation.
